coach_note: Wed Nov 25 - Portofino, upper-body day. Recovery is the best it's been all month: 8.1 h sleep, HRV 45 (avg 43), readiness 84, body battery 80, and yesterday was 111 easy minutes on the bike. Chest and back were last worked Sunday, so they're ready. Push-ups return with all three variants doing three different jobs; the row and pulldown are warm-up + one top set taken past the number; then the pulling progression continues with a dead hang and slow negatives on the assisted machine, nothing to failure. Decline bench replaces the crunch machine. 20 easy minutes on the Peloton at the end closes the week's last 4 Zone 2 minutes, and the leg lifts and squats finish their weekly counts. No hamstring work.

exercises.note: Warm-up: 10 min easy, just enough to be warm before the hanging. Zone 2 comes at the end.

Set 1 decline AMRAP with the feet on a bench (higher than Sunday's 35). Rest 2 min. Set 2 flat AMRAP (50 Sunday). Set 3 incline close-grip, 3 s down, pause at the bottom - a tricep set; stop around 15 or when the elbows flare.
Sunday's top set was 90 x23 - that earns 100. Warm-up, then 100 AMRAP; stop when the shoulders start shrugging up.
Last 85 x15 with room. Warm-up, then 95 AMRAP, bar to the collarbone, no leaning back past 15 degrees.
Two hangs, shoulders packed. Yesterday's first one was 25 s - aim for 35 today, stop when the grip opens. 90 s between.
Negatives, not pull-ups: set the assist to -100, pull or step to the top, lower over a full 5 seconds. One set of 4. If the 4th drops faster than 3 s, stop at 3. Vertical grip.
Nov 18 top set 80 x15. One warm-up at 50, then 85 AMRAP with a 1 s squeeze.
Saturday 55/75 x15. Warm-up at 50, then 80 AMRAP - small movement, no swinging.
Saturday 65 x10 - this one is already near failure, so stay at 65 and just log the honest number.
Replaces the crunch machine. One AMRAP set, hands across the chest, curl up - then one set of 15.
Week is at 110 of 140. One slow AMRAP (30 Sunday) closes it.
Week is at 120 of 140. One slow-tempo set of 20 and it's done.
Finisher: 20 min with 15 of them held at 120-129 bpm. Week needs 4 more Zone 2 minutes; this gives margin.
